scripts.kill-metro: lsof -ti:8081 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || echo 'No process on port 8081'
scripts.ios: eval "$(rbenv init -)" && SIM_UDID="$(node scripts/ios-destinations.js 'iPhone 17 Pro')" && rock run:ios --device "$SIM_UDID"
scripts.deploy:ios:rock-beta-github: (cd ios && BUNDLE_GEMFILE="$(pwd)/../Gemfile" bundle exec fastlane rock_beta)
scripts.deploy:ios:rock-release-github: (cd ios && BUNDLE_GEMFILE="$(pwd)/../Gemfile" bundle exec fastlane rock_release)
scripts.deploy:ios:bump-build: eval "$(rbenv init -)" && ./scripts/ensure-ios-deps.sh && (cd ios && BUNDLE_GEMFILE="$(pwd)/../Gemfile" bundle exec fastlane bump_build)
scripts.deploy:ios:bump-patch: eval "$(rbenv init -)" && ./scripts/ensure-ios-deps.sh && (cd ios && BUNDLE_GEMFILE="$(pwd)/../Gemfile" bundle exec fastlane bump_version_patch)
scripts.deploy:ios:clean: eval "$(rbenv init -)" && ./scripts/ensure-ios-deps.sh && (cd ios && BUNDLE_GEMFILE="$(pwd)/../Gemfile" bundle exec fastlane clean)
scripts.build:ios: echo '🔨 Building iOS app with Rock...' && pnpm run version:ios:bump && eval "$(rbenv init -)" && ./scripts/ensure-ios-deps.sh && BUILD_DATE="$(date +%Y-%m-%d)" && mkdir -p "build-logs/build-ios/$BUILD_DATE" && LOG_PATH="build-logs/build-ios/$BUILD_DATE/build-$(date +%H-%M-%S).log" && echo "📦 Building and deploying iOS app..." && (cd ios && BUNDLE_GEMFILE="$(pwd)/../Gemfile" bundle exec fastlane rock_beta 2>&1) | tee "$LOG_PATH"; BUILD_STATUS=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; if [ $BUILD_STATUS -eq 0 ]; then echo "" && echo "✅ Build completed successfully!" && echo "📄 Full log: $LOG_PATH"; else echo "" && echo "❌ Build failed!" && echo "📄 Full log: $LOG_PATH" && exit 1; fi
scripts.build:ios:archive-local: BUILD_DATE="$(date +%Y-%m-%d)" && mkdir -p "build-logs/archive-local/$BUILD_DATE" && LOG_PATH="build-logs/archive-local/$BUILD_DATE/archive-$(date +%H-%M-%S).log" && ERROR_LOG="${LOG_PATH%.log}-key-errors.log" && echo "📦 Building iOS archive locally..." && (cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace FajrEMR.xcworkspace -scheme FajrEMR -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath ../.rock/cache/ios/archive/FajrEMR.xcarchive archive 2>&1) | tee "$LOG_PATH"; BUILD_STATUS=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; echo "" && echo "🔍 Extracting key errors..." && { echo "====== BUILD SUMMARY ======" && tail -50 "$LOG_PATH" | grep -E "(ARCHIVE|BUILD|FAILED|SUCCEEDED|failure|error)" && echo "" && echo "====== KEY ERRORS ======" && grep -i "error:" "$LOG_PATH" | head -20 && echo "" && echo "====== BUILD PHASE FAILURES ======" && grep -i "PhaseScriptExecution.*failed\|The following build commands failed" "$LOG_PATH" && echo "" && echo "====== ERROR CONTEXT (5 lines before/after each error) ======" && grep -B 5 -A 5 -i "error:" "$LOG_PATH" | head -100 && echo "" && echo "====== FATAL ERRORS ======" && grep -i "fatal\|cannot find\|no such file" "$LOG_PATH" | head -20; } > "$ERROR_LOG" 2>&1; if [ $BUILD_STATUS -eq 0 ]; then echo "" && echo "✅ Archive completed successfully!" && echo "📄 Full log: $LOG_PATH" && echo "📋 Key errors (empty if successful): $ERROR_LOG"; else echo "" && echo "❌ Archive failed!" && echo "📄 Full log: $LOG_PATH" && echo "📋 Key errors extracted to: $ERROR_LOG" && echo "" && echo "=== QUICK ERROR SUMMARY ===" && cat "$ERROR_LOG" && exit 1; fi
scripts.build:ios:archive-fresh: pnpm run version:ios:bump && BUILD_DATE="$(date +%Y-%m-%d)" && mkdir -p "build-logs/archive-fresh/$BUILD_DATE" && LOG_PATH="build-logs/archive-fresh/$BUILD_DATE/archive-fresh-$(date +%H-%M-%S).log" && echo "🔥 Building FRESH iOS archive (clearing cache)..." && rm -rf .rock/cache/ios/archive/* .rock/cache/ios/export/* && (cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace FajrEMR.xcworkspace -scheme FajrEMR -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath ../.rock/cache/ios/archive/FajrEMR.xcarchive archive 2>&1) | tee "$LOG_PATH"; BUILD_STATUS=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; if [ $BUILD_STATUS -eq 0 ]; then echo "" && echo "✅ Fresh archive completed successfully!" && echo "📄 Full log: $LOG_PATH"; else echo "" && echo "❌ Archive failed!" && echo "📄 Full log: $LOG_PATH" && exit 1; fi
scripts.build:ios:test-bundle: echo '📦 Testing React Native bundle generation...' && rock bundle --platform ios --entry-file index.js --dev false --bundle-output test-bundle.js && echo '✅ Bundle created successfully' && rm -f test-bundle.js
scripts.build:info: echo '📱 Current iOS Version:' && pnpm run version:ios
scripts.fastlane:sync:force: eval "$(rbenv init -)" && ./scripts/ensure-ios-deps.sh && cd ios && source fastlane/.match.env && BUNDLE_GEMFILE="$(pwd)/../Gemfile" bundle exec fastlane match appstore --force --team_id "$TEAM_ID" --username "$APPLE_ID" --app_identifier "$APP_IDENTIFIER" --keychain_name "$KEYCHAIN_NAME" --keychain_password "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD"
